moments.title: Roger Waters turns 83
moments.blurb: Pink Floyd co-founder, bassist, and principal lyricist Roger Waters celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Pink Floyd's architect
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to Roger Waters! The visionary behind so many Pink Floyd classics, from Dark Side of the Moon to The Wall. What's your favourite Waters-penned track?

angles.name: A musical legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Roger Waters! His influence on rock music is immense. Still rocking at 83!

moments.title: Swansea International Jazz Festival concludes
moments.blurb: The Swansea International Jazz Festival wraps up today after four days of performances from international, UK, and Welsh jazz artists.

angles.name: Last day of Jazz
angles.copy: It's the final day of the Swansea International Jazz Festival! If you're in the city, there's still time to catch some incredible live music. What's been your highlight?

angles.name: Jazz in Swansea
angles.copy: Today marks the end of the Swansea International Jazz Festival! A fantastic showcase of talent across the city. Who did you manage to see?

moments.title: Gloria Gaynor's 83rd Birthday
moments.blurb: Disco icon and 'I Will Survive' singer Gloria Gaynor turns 83 tomorrow, September 7th.

angles.name: Queen of Disco
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the Queen of Disco, Gloria Gaynor, celebrates her 83rd birthday! Still surviving and thriving. What's your go-to Gloria track?

angles.name: I Will Survive legend
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! The legendary Gloria Gaynor turns 83 tomorrow. Her voice defined an era and continues to inspire.

moments.title: P!nk turns 47
moments.blurb: Pop-rock superstar P!nk, known for hits like 'Get the Party Started' and 'So What', celebrates her 47th birthday on September 8th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday P!nk
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 47th Birthday to the incredible P!nk on Tuesday! From 'Just Like A Pill' to 'Trustfall', she always delivers. What's your favourite P!nk anthem?

angles.name: Pop-rock icon
angles.copy: P!nk turns 47 on Tuesday! A true pop-rock icon with an amazing career and unforgettable live shows. Raise your glass to her!

moments.title: José Feliciano's 81st Birthday
moments.blurb: Puerto Rican singer-songwriter and guitarist José Feliciano, famous for 'Light My Fire' and 'Feliz Navidad', turns 81 on September 10th.

angles.name: Feliz Cumpleaños José
angles.copy: On Thursday, the incredible José Feliciano celebrates his 81st birthday! From 'Light My Fire' to 'Feliz Navidad', his guitar and voice are iconic. What's your favourite of his songs?

angles.name: Guitar legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 81st birthday to the legendary José Feliciano this Thursday. A true virtuoso with a career spanning decades!

moments.title: Wales Festival of Seaweed kicks off
moments.blurb: The Wales Festival of Seaweed begins on September 10th in St Davids, Pembrokeshire, celebrating the benefits of seaweed with food, talks, and workshops.

angles.name: Pembrokeshire's Seaweed Celebration
angles.copy: Something unique is happening in Pembrokeshire this week! The Wales Festival of Seaweed kicks off on Thursday in St Davids. Get ready to explore its culinary and environmental wonders!

angles.name: Discover Seaweed in St Davids
angles.copy: From September 10th-13th, St Davids hosts the Wales Festival of Seaweed! Cooking demos, expert talks, and live music – celebrating the ocean's green gold.

moments.title: Moby turns 61
moments.blurb: Electronic music pioneer Moby, known for albums like 'Play' and '18', celebrates his 61st birthday on September 11th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Moby
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 61st Birthday to the incredible Moby this Friday! From 'Porcelain' to 'Why Does My Heart Feel So Bad?', his tracks are timeless. What's your favourite Moby moment?

angles.name: Electronic music legend
angles.copy: Moby turns 61 on Friday! A true electronic music legend and animal rights activist. His sound shaped a generation.

moments.title: Jennifer Hudson turns 45
moments.blurb: EGOT winner, singer, and actress Jennifer Hudson celebrates her 45th birthday on September 12th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday JHud
angles.copy: Happy 45th Birthday to the phenomenal Jennifer Hudson on Saturday! From American Idol to an EGOT winner, her talent is undeniable. What's your favourite Jennifer Hudson song or performance?

angles.name: Vocal powerhouse
angles.copy: Jennifer Hudson celebrates her 45th birthday this Saturday! A vocal powerhouse and incredible actress. Wishing her a fantastic day!

moments.title: Nas turns 53
moments.blurb: Legendary American rapper and songwriter Nas, known for his seminal album 'Illmatic', celebrates his 53rd birthday on September 14th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Nas
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 53rd Birthday to the iconic Nas on Monday! A true wordsmith whose impact on hip-hop is immeasurable. What's your favourite Nas track?

angles.name: Hip-hop legend
angles.copy: Nas turns 53 this Monday! A pivotal figure in hip-hop history, consistently delivering powerful lyrics and storytelling.

moments.title: Marc Anthony turns 58
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning American singer, songwriter, and actor Marc Anthony, the top-selling salsa artist of all time, celebrates his 58th birthday on September 16th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Marc Anthony
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 58th Birthday to the 'King of Salsa', Marc Anthony, on Wednesday! His incredible voice and Latin rhythms are unmistakable. What's your favourite Marc Anthony song?

angles.name: Salsa King
angles.copy: Marc Anthony turns 58 this Wednesday! A global music icon with a string of hits that get everyone dancing. Celebrate his birthday with some classic Latin vibes!

moments.title: Cadw Open Doors Festival continues
moments.blurb: Cadw's Open Doors festival offers free entry to hundreds of historic sites and cultural attractions across Wales throughout September 2026.

angles.name: Explore Wales for Free
angles.copy: Throughout September, Cadw's Open Doors festival means free entry to incredible historic sites across Wales! Discover a hidden gem or revisit a favourite. Where will you explore?

angles.name: Welsh Heritage Month
angles.copy: September is your chance to delve into Wales' rich heritage for free! The Cadw Open Doors festival is running all month, with hundreds of sites welcoming visitors.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 launch date announced
moments.blurb: The BBC has announced that the launch show for Strictly Come Dancing 2026 will air on Saturday, September 19th, featuring new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly is back!
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha-cha! The BBC has officially announced that Strictly Come Dancing returns for its launch show on Saturday, September 19th! New hosts, new celebs, same glitterball dreams!

angles.name: New Strictly hosts
angles.copy: The countdown to Strictly has begun! The launch show is set for September 19th, and we'll see Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe take over hosting duties. What do you think of the new line-up?
